content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 17th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture or B.Sc. (Hons.) in Botany, Microbiology, Environmental Science, Biotechnology, Geography, GIS and Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, or Chemistry.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant (PA) post at ICAR Central Rice Research Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR Central Rice Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The institute is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview. A screening test may be conducted if there is a large number of candidates.
